602-4691-5435.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
602-4691-5435.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability, giving Dream Trawler hexproof until end of turn and tapping it
Repeat

792-4279-7918--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-7918--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

710-2730-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Danitha enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2063-4695-8089.description:
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1170-5131-6797-7010--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-6797-7010--202.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1170-5131-6797-7010--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gran-Gran.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

620-2111-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1379-6620-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-6620-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Sylvan Safekeeper.

433-3756-7857.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

1303-2438-3249-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Shambling Ghast enters, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of Shambling Ghast.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing both Shambling Ghasts.
When the Shambling Ghasts die, they triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

4681-5686-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7060-7686.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
3259-7060-7686.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3532-3761-5078-7692.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3761-5078-7692.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Arcbound Crusher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Crusher.
Repeat.

618-7626.description:
Activate the mutated Vulpikeet and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

3532-5060-5078-7314.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-7314.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1402-3593-3698-4359.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Diamond Lion enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 4, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3169-4943-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {2}.
When Lancers en-Kor enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

4017-5086-5183-5231-6705.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-5086-5183-5231-6705.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

2438-4053-4336-6989.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-5205-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Glint-Sleeve Artisan.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glint-Sleeve Artisan enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1987-3227-4276-5913.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3227-4276-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and Scrivener.
When Pinnacle Monk and Scrivener enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3227-4276-5913.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

5147-5220-6538-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

3525-6006-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Servant of Tymaret.
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Dryad of the Ilysian Grove

225-280-4572-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
225-280-4572-5702.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm. When it enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant, Golgari Rot Farm and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad of the Ilysian Grove.
Because of the additional Dryad of the Ilysian Grove token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

4936-5630-5632-6689.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4936-5630-5632-6689.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Golbez and Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Golbez trigger, putting Moss-Pit Skeleton from the top of your library into your graveyard.
Resolve the Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-2020-3263-6577.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2511-3090-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
2511-3090-5434-5555.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

3976-5211-6221.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
3976-5211-6221.description:
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, putting Brass's Bounty from your graveyard onto the battlefield face down as a 3/3 creature.
Activate Etrata by paying {2}{U}{B}, exiling Brass's Bounty and causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{B}{B}{R}.
Repeat.
3976-5211-6221.notes: If you control eight or more lands, this combo nets infinite mana. If you have infinite mana, you may use it to repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery in your graveyard in place of Brass's Bounty, so long as the instant or sorcery will go to the graveyard on resolution and does not require colorless mana.

1872-2178-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Saheeli.
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1872-2178-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When the Composite Golem token dies, Saheeli triggers, untapping Saheeli.
Repeat.

4050-4863-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Revolutionist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Revolutionist, adding {B}.
When Revolutionist dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Revolutionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

283-3445-3930.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Rimewind Taskmage.
Rimewind Taskmage does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four snow permanents.
283-3445-3930.description:
Activate the land with Glittering Frost attached by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Glittering Frost triggers, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Rimewind Taskmage by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Rimewind Taskmage's ability, targeting the land with Glittering Frost attached.
Resolve both abilities, untapping Rimewind Taskmage and the land.
Repeat.

323-2530-2577-3983.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Gravecrawler enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Carnival of Souls and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1379-1651-5251.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token that is also an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

2438-4191-4902-5220.description:
Cast Council of Advisors by paying {0}.
Council of Advisors enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Council of Advisors.
Council of Advisors dies, triggering Mortuary, putting Council of Advisors on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Council of Advisors trigger from step 2, causing you to draw Council of Advisors from the top of your library.
Repeat.
